text:
marta: FYI Pinecrest (BAA customer) reporting missing audit entries after our recent KMS rotation + HSM migration. They say exports show a 403 for a subset of ids and retention timestamps don't match their copy. TL;DR: export failing since rotation at 2024-10-18T03:24Z.
marta: customer ticket link: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/CH-8123 and export id: export_20241018_03_42
camille: can you paste the failing export request/response (redact PII)? 403 body + request id would help. also which key alias did we rotate?
marta: sending snippet from Pinecrest: 
```
POST /v1/audit/export HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
{ "start_time": "2024-10-17T00:00:00Z", "end_time": "2024-10-18T04:00:00Z" }

HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
{ "error": "permission_denied", "message": "kms:Decrypt failed for key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd-rotated", "request_id": "req_0a1b2c3d" }
```
camille: thanks. that error string suggests the export service lost access to the rotated CMK version. ashwin — we switched Pinecrest to HSM-backed key (key alias pinecrest-baa-cmk) and rotated versions last week, right?
ashwin: (secops) yes — alias pinecrest-baa-cmk now points to key version v3, old v1/v2 still exist but we removed the export-service grant on v1 during rotation process to enforce new access controls. i had assumed the export microservice was updated to use the alias — apparently it's caching a key ARN.
jordan: quick repro steps i ran on staging:
1) create a test alias -> point to new key version
2) run export job (same binary) -> succeeds if export-service IAM has decrypt on alias, fails if it references the literal arn of prior key version.
example command: 
```bash
aws kms list-keys --region us-east-1
aws kms list-aliases --region us-east-1 --key-id alias/pinecrest-baa-cmk
# show grants
aws kms list-grants --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd-rotated
```
jordan: logs show export-service initialization prints the literal ARN it cached: `Using KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd-rotated`
secops: that explains the 403. For HSM-backed keys the alias is stable but internal key id changes; services must use alias not versioned ARN.
camille: possible mitigation for customer: temporarily re-grant decrypt on the old key version to export-service so they can complete backfill. long term: update service to look up alias at runtime or ensure alias resolution on startup after rotation.
marta: Pinecrest asking for timeline and evidence for our BAA audit — they need an export of access logs and key rotation attestation. what's the quickest path to produce that?
ashwin: we can provide:
- KMS key rotation history (cloudtrail entries)
- HSM attestation PDF from vendor (we have the last monthly report)
- Grant/grant-revocation events for the key (list-grants and cloudtrail)
I can assemble and redact.
camille: also note the export job that failed had request_id req_0a1b2c3d. ops: can we re-run that export after temporary grant? it should pick up missing entries.
jordan: i'll coordinate a temporary grant and run a controlled re-export to a secure bucket and share a presigned link to Pinecrest legal. will also capture the command outputs and CloudTrail event ids.
marta: customer update drafted: "We're investigating. Temporary access will be granted to complete your export; we'll provide rotation history and HSM attestation. No data integrity loss; this was an access policy mismatch during rotation." happy to post once you confirm. :thumbsup:
secops: one more follow-up — we should add an automated check in the rotation playbook: after alias update, run `export-service --dry-run --check-kms` which attempts a Decrypt on alias to validate permissions. i can open a short RFC.
camille: agreed; also, add a fallback in export service to resolve alias on each export invocation for N minutes to avoid long-lived cached ARNs.
marta: thanks team. action items: ashwin to assemble audit artifacts (ETA 6h), jordan to run temp-grant + re-export (ETA 2h), camille to add quick hotfix PR for alias resolution (ETA 24h). i'll update customer in 1h.
audit-export-bot: Export job req_0a1b2c3d re-scheduled by jordan at 2024-10-18T07:12Z -> status: pending
marta: noted; closing loop once export is uploaded. :eyes:
